title: papaver pilosum subsp. strictum
intro: Papaver pilosum subsp. strictum, commonly known as Himalayan poppy, is a plant species belonging to the Papaveraceae family, characterized by its hairy stems and blue-violet flowers. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, inflammation, and wounds, due to its rich content of bioactive compounds that provide numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Papaver pilosum subsp. strictum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can help alleviate pain, reduce inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
